title: A sheaf of abelian groups on a basis extends to a sheaf on the space
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and $\mathcal B$ a set of open subsets of $X$ which is a basis of the topology and satisfies $U\cap V\in\mathcal B$ for all $U,V\in\mathcal B$. Let $F$ be a presheaf of abelian groups on $\mathcal B$: abelian groups $F(U)$ for $U\in\mathcal B$ and group homomorphisms $r_{U,V}:F(U)\to F(V)$ for $V\subseteq U$ in $\mathcal B$ with $r_{U,U}=\mathrm{id}$ and $r_{V,W}r_{U,V}=r_{U,W}$. Suppose that for every $U\in\mathcal B$ and every family $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ of members of $\mathcal B$ with $\bigcup_iU_i=U$ ($I$ arbitrary, possibly empty) and every family $s_i\in F(U_i)$ with $r_{U_i,U_i\cap U_j}(s_i)=r_{U_j,U_i\cap U_j}(s_j)$ for all $i,j$, there is exactly one $s\in F(U)$ with $r_{U,U_i}(s)=s_i$ for all $i$. Then there is a sheaf of abelian groups $F^{ext}$ on $X$ together with group isomorphisms $\iota_U:F^{ext}(U)\to F(U)$ for $U\in\mathcal B$ such that $\iota_V(t|_V)=r_{U,V}(\iota_U(t))$ for $V\subseteq U$ in $\mathcal B$ and $t\in F^{ext}(U)$.

source.place: Sheaves on Spaces, Section 009H: Lemma 009M (label lemma-condition-star-sections), Lemma 009N (label lemma-extend-off-basis) with its proof (F^ext(W) = families of germs (s_x) in the stalks F_x = colim_{x in U in B} F(U) satisfying (*); sheaf by the argument of Lemma 007Y, label lemma-sheafification-sheaf), Lemma 009Q (label lemma-extend-off-basis-structures) for the abelian group structure; Definition 009J and Lemma 009L for the form of the sheaf condition when B is closed under intersections

proof.text: *Stalks and sections over members of $\mathcal B$.* For $x\in X$ let $F_x=\operatorname{colim}_{x\in U\in\mathcal B}F(U)$ be the stalk of $F$ with its germ homomorphisms $\sigma\mapsto\sigma_x$, which satisfy $(r_{U,V}\sigma)_x=\sigma_x$ for $x\in V\subseteq U$ in $\mathcal B$ [def-weil-pbc-basis-presheaf-stalk]. For $U\in\mathcal B$ let $\gamma_U:F(U)\to\prod_{x\in U}F_x$, $s\mapsto(s_x)_{x\in U}$. Since $F$ satisfies the gluing hypothesis of the statement for all $\mathcal B$-coverings and $\mathcal B$ is a basis closed under pairwise intersections, [lem-weil-pbc-basis-sheaf-sections-germs] applies: $\gamma_U$ is injective and its image is the set of families $(t_x)_{x\in U}$ satisfying (*): every $x\in U$ has $V\in\mathcal B$ with $x\in V\subseteq U$ and $\sigma\in F(V)$ with $t_y=\sigma_y$ for all $y\in V$.

source.place: Section 009H: the stalk after Definition 009I (label definition-presheaf-basis); Lemma 009M (label lemma-condition-star-sections)

proof.text: *The extension as a sheaf of sets.* For an open $W\subseteq X$ let $F^{ext}(W)\subseteq\prod_{x\in W}F_x$ be the set of families $(t_x)_{x\in W}$ satisfying (*) relative to $W$: every $x\in W$ has $V\in\mathcal B$ with $x\in V\subseteq W$ and $\sigma\in F(V)$ with $t_y=\sigma_y$ for all $y\in V$; for open $W'\subseteq W$ the restriction is $(t_x)_{x\in W}\mapsto(t_x)_{x\in W'}$. The two conditions of [lem-weil-pbc-local-predicate-sections-sheaf] hold for $T_x=F_x$ and $P(W)=F^{ext}(W)$. (i) Restriction: let $t\in F^{ext}(W)$, $W'\subseteq W$ open and $x\in W'$; take $V,\sigma$ for $t$ at $x$; as $\mathcal B$ is a basis there is $V'\in\mathcal B$ with $x\in V'\subseteq V\cap W'$; then $\sigma'=r_{V,V'}(\sigma)\in F(V')$ satisfies $\sigma'_y=\sigma_y=t_y$ for $y\in V'$ [def-weil-pbc-basis-presheaf-stalk], which is (*) for $(t_x)_{x\in W'}$ at $x$. (ii) Locality: if $t\in\prod_{x\in W}F_x$ and every $x\in W$ has an open $V_0$ with $x\in V_0\subseteq W$ and $(t_y)_{y\in V_0}\in F^{ext}(V_0)$, then (*) for $(t_y)_{y\in V_0}$ at $x$ gives $V\in\mathcal B$, $x\in V\subseteq V_0\subseteq W$, and $\sigma\in F(V)$ with $t_y=\sigma_y$ on $V$: this is (*) for $t$ at $x$. Hence by [lem-weil-pbc-local-predicate-sections-sheaf] $F^{ext}$ is a sheaf of sets on $X$: for every open covering $W=\bigcup_kW_k$ and families $t^k\in F^{ext}(W_k)$ agreeing on all $W_k\cap W_l$ there is exactly one $t\in F^{ext}(W)$ restricting to every $t^k$.

source.place: Section 009H, Lemma 009N (label lemma-extend-off-basis), proof: F^ext(U) = families satisfying (*) of Lemma 009M, a presheaf by restriction of families, a sheaf 'as in the proof of Lemma 007Y' (label lemma-sheafification-sheaf, Section 007X)

proof.text: *The group structure.* Each $F^{ext}(W)$ is a subgroup of the abelian group $\prod_{x\in W}F_x$ (componentwise operations). Zero: for $x\in W$ choose $V\in\mathcal B$ with $x\in V\subseteq W$ ($\mathcal B$ a basis) and $\sigma=0\in F(V)$; $0_y=\sigma_y$ for $y\in V$ since germ maps are homomorphisms. Sums and negatives: if $t,t'\in F^{ext}(W)$ and $x\in W$, take $V,\sigma$ for $t$ and $V',\sigma'$ for $t'$ at $x$; then $V''=V\cap V'\in\mathcal B$, $x\in V''\subseteq W$, and $\sigma''=r_{V,V''}(\sigma)+r_{V',V''}(\sigma')$ (resp. $-r_{V,V''}(\sigma)$) satisfies $\sigma''_y=\sigma_y+\sigma'_y=t_y+t'_y$ (resp. $-t_y$) for $y\in V''$, because germ maps are homomorphisms compatible with restriction [def-weil-pbc-basis-presheaf-stalk]. The restriction maps of $F^{ext}$ are restrictions of the coordinate projections $\prod_{x\in W}F_x\to\prod_{x\in W'}F_x$, hence homomorphisms, and they are compatible with composition. So $F^{ext}$ is a presheaf of abelian groups whose underlying presheaf of sets is the sheaf of step 2; the gluing condition for a presheaf of abelian groups is the same statement about the underlying sets, so $F^{ext}$ is a sheaf of abelian groups on $X$.

source.place: Section 009H, Lemma 009Q (label lemma-extend-off-basis-structures), proof: it suffices to construct F^ext on the level of underlying presheaves of sets and to see that the structure of the stalks makes F^ext(U) an object of the algebraic category; for abelian groups this is the subgroup of the product of stalks written out here (Stacks leaves the details to the reader)

proof.text: *The isomorphisms $\iota_U$.* Let $U\in\mathcal B$. For $s\in F(U)$ the family $\gamma_U(s)=(s_x)_{x\in U}$ satisfies (*) relative to $U$ (take $V=U$, $\sigma=s$), so $\gamma_U$ is a map $F(U)\to F^{ext}(U)$; it is a homomorphism since the germ maps are; it is injective and surjective onto $F^{ext}(U)$ by step 1 ([lem-weil-pbc-basis-sheaf-sections-germs]: its image is exactly the set of families satisfying (*), which is $F^{ext}(U)$ by definition). Put $\iota_U=\gamma_U^{-1}:F^{ext}(U)\to F(U)$, a group isomorphism. Compatibility: for $V\subseteq U$ in $\mathcal B$ and $s\in F(U)$, $\gamma_V(r_{U,V}(s))=((r_{U,V}s)_y)_{y\in V}=(s_y)_{y\in V}=\gamma_U(s)|_V$ [def-weil-pbc-basis-presheaf-stalk]; with $t=\gamma_U(s)$, i.e. $s=\iota_U(t)$, this reads $\iota_V(t|_V)=r_{U,V}(\iota_U(t))$ for all $t\in F^{ext}(U)$.

source.place: Section 009H, Lemma 009N (label lemma-extend-off-basis), proof: 'by Lemma 009M we see that F(U) = F^ext(U) whenever U is an element of the basis B', compatibly with restrictions; Lemma 009Q for the group structure

split_report.summary: Decided not a Mathlib leaf. The comparison-lemma route was read in the source: Functor.sheafInducedTopologyEquivOfIsCoverDense (InducedTopology.lean:159) is IsDenseSubsite.sheafEquiv = (sheafPushforwardContinuous ..).asEquivalence.symm (DenseSubsite/Basic.lean:797), so with G = inducedFunctor of B (cover dense by TopCat.Opens.coverDense_inducedFunctor, Sites.lean:135) and A = AddCommGrpCat its functor gives F^ext and the component at U of the isomorphism inverse.obj (functor.obj F) ≅ F (inverse = restriction along G) gives iota_U, naturality giving compatibility: one declaration per clause there. But the hypothesis is not yet Presheaf.IsSheaf (G.inducedTopology _) F: it needs isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget (Sheaf.lean:730), isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_of_type, mem_inducedTopology_iff_of_isCoverDense with Opens.mem_grothendieckTopology (a sieve S on U in B covers iff its members cover U), and then an argument that a compatible family for S is a family agreeing on pairwise intersections (V ∩ V' in B and in S) and conversely, for which there is no single declaration (isSheafFor_arrows_iff_pullbacks needs HasPairwisePullbacks in the category of members of B, which no instance gives; Precoverage.toGrothendieck_comap_eq_restrictedTopology needs a precoverage presentation of the topology of X). So, as instructed, the item is split along Stacks 009N/009Q: (1) stalks on B (new def-weil-pbc-basis-presheaf-stalk, Mathlib leaf: a colimit in AddCommGrpCat) and Lemma 009M (new lem-weil-pbc-basis-sheaf-sections-germs, unsplit); (2) F^ext(W) = families of germs satisfying (*), a local predicate, hence a sheaf by Stacks 007Y = TopCat.subpresheafToTypes.isSheaf (new lem-weil-pbc-local-predicate-sections-sheaf, Mathlib leaf); (3) F^ext(W) is a subgroup of the product of stalks (Stacks 009Q, details written out); (4) iota_U = inverse of s ↦ (s_x), bijective by 009M, compatible with restrictions. The comparison-lemma route stays recorded in mathlib_searches as a generalization candidate. Statement unchanged; lean_audit none on both branches; the source repository has no extension-from-basis declaration (inducedTopology occurs only in hasSheafify_inducedTopology_equivSmallModel and the small-model sheafification instances, all sorry-free and unrelated).
